scope: Sanitized public summary of SN001 experiments; values copied from private evidence identified in release_manifest.json

standing_reaching.status: OBSERVED (no formal closure record); assessment PROMISING for nominal reaching, NOT evidence of learned balance
standing_reaching.plant: sn001_sim_v1: official-source ergoCubSN001 (27 joints, 57.1045 kg), position servos Kp 1000 / actuator Kv 0 / passive damping 2, official box contacts, 500 Hz physics / 50 Hz policy, simulation-only experimental effort caps
standing_reaching.task: sn001_reference_standing_left_reach_v1: fixed left-palm target 50 mm in front of the reset palm (no jitter), success = palm within 30 mm for 0.5 s with upright/height conditions, 10 s (500-command) cap
standing_reaching.observation: 90-D: 27 joint angles and velocities, projected gravity, root-local linear and angular velocity, root height above floor, target-minus-palm vector, previous action (simulator ground truth; privileged relative to hardware sensing)

training.lineage: fresh relaunch from scratch after a first launch stopped at driver step 79 on a reporting diagnostic; the stopped run was not used for initialization or evaluation

training_replay.note: 4 terminal (fall/guard) steps in 110,000 training records, all in the first ~12.6k steps; every other training episode reached the 10 s cap or a logging boundary. The untrained policy already survives, consistent with the zero-action baseline.

standing_reaching.evaluation_protocol: 20 independent stochastic-policy seeds (1000-1019) per checkpoint, nominal reset, fixed target, CPU, 0 optimizer updates, checkpoint hashes unchanged

paired_110k_minus_75k.note: paired matched-seed bootstrap, 20,000 resamples; marginal, not multiplicity-adjusted; one training seed

zero_action_10s.note: one deterministic episode; protocol written before the run

nominal_hold_common_5s.note: saved 5 s nominal-hold trial from the readiness checks; within that window only

kinematic_decomposition.note: most hand approach is whole-base positioning/lean; copied from the task-validity audit (kinematic decomposition, not a counterfactual)

checkpoint_scope.intermediate: 75,000 driver steps (the only saved intermediate milestone; e2408378...)
checkpoint_scope.beyond_110k: no SN001 standing/reaching run beyond 110,000 steps exists; the 200,000-step SN001 runs are the two walking seeds, on a different plant (Motor V2 contract) and task
checkpoint_scope.milestone_dating: training episodes reach the 10 s cap from the first episodes, so no survival or balance milestone can be dated; training score rises until about 70-80k and then plateaus

standing_reaching.best_defensible_demonstration: 110k final checkpoint (3d8267e3...) as the final model; 75k is equivalent on survival and reaching incidence and better on first-second error, so neither strictly dominates.

v2_matched_budget.note: descriptive only: different plant (V2 servos do not hold the robot under zero action), cohorts and task packages

clip.selection: first seed of the cohort (seed index 1000), chosen by the identity audit before this release

walking.plant: sn001_sim_v2 Motor V2 contract candidate on the official SN001 geometry: 23 servos Kp 25.266 / Kd 2.011, armature 0.01, effort caps 60/110/17/20 Nm, passive neck/camera, implicitfast 2 ms x 10; NOT the sn001_sim_v1 standing plant
walking.task: sn001_walking_v3: forward COM speed reward saturating at 0.2 m/s while upright and loaded, small effort and slip penalties, -1 on fall, no survival term; Event V3 terminals (height < 0.8, tilt > 30 deg, joint > 0.01 rad beyond range, any contact deeper than 5 mm); 500-command cap
walking.observation: 88-D: joint angles and velocities, projected gravity, root-local linear and angular velocity, root height above floor, speed command, previous action (simulator ground truth; no contact sensing)

seed0.lineage: pilot 0 -> 10,000 steps (from scratch, completed); continuation 10,000 -> about 80,100, interrupted externally (machine restart); verified recovery from the 80,100-step checkpoint to 200,000 (completed)

seed2.lineage: 0 -> 200,000 steps from scratch, uninterrupted; no inherited weights or replay

walking.evaluation_protocol: 30 stochastic episodes per seed, evaluation sampling seed 0, deterministic reset, CPU, 0 updates, MuJoCo contact forces at every 2 ms substep

q1.note: the reward pays forward COM speed only; no incremental payment for contact transitions; a forward step was never constructed

q2.note: predictions are uninformed where stepping would begin; causal role not identifiable offline; imagined action rankings not measured

q3.note: valid physical event of low incidence; one policy toe-corner touchdown crossed it

diagnostic_lift.controller: hand-designed, true-state feedback (not a learned policy)
diagnostic_lift.note: stationary left-foot lift; NOT a forward step or a gait

walking.attribution: No single cause isolated among plant/interface feasibility, task incentives, DreamerV3 learning and simulation infrastructure; incentives have the strongest explanatory (not interventional) support. No comparator learner was trained.
